content.short: Coinone runs licensed Korean won markets for Bitcoin, Ethereum and many other digital assets.
content.description: Coinone opened in the early days of Korean crypto trading and remains a major venue for won-denominated trading. Customers deposit and withdraw Korean won, trade a broad list of digital assets against it, and use the API for automated trading. The exchange operates under Korea's licensing rules for virtual asset service providers, with real-name bank account checks for every user.
content.meta: Licensed Korean exchange for trading Bitcoin, Ethereum and more against the won. Explore Coinone on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
